description: End-to-end v0.1 happy-path run against a seeded scratch repository. Three unreviewed agent commits are imported by `debtflow init`; a fourth agent commit lands stacked on the oldest entry and interest visibly rises between two `debtflow board` reads while the new commit is auto-imported; the three settle verbs (paydown, refinance, default) then close the ledger and the savepoint-tree restore leaves the working tree clean.

commits.author: Claude <claude@anthropic.com>
commits.subject: feat: make the interest rate a constant
commits.note: lands after debtflow init; the .gitignore entry is the ledger directory line debtflow init appended

observations: Interest accrues between runs without a separate command: between the two board reads the oldest entry ea80b317137b rose from 2 dependent commits / blast radius 2 to 3 / 4, entry 5c4cce760a41 from 1 / 3 to 2 / 5, and entry 537d8750bd73 from 0 / 0 to 1 / 3.
The new agent commit d5581a8db90c was auto-imported as a fresh open row by `debtflow board` itself — no separate init needed once the ledger exists.
`debtflow refinance 5c4cce760a41 537d8750bd73` marked both source entries refinanced and opened bundle 88fc0922c3ea covering their combined file set (5 touched files).
`debtflow default d5581a8db90c` restored the recorded pre-change tree refs/debtflow/d5581a8db90c and committed it; the working tree was left clean (empty git status output above).
The final board shows all four ledger states at once: one paid entry, two refinanced sources, the still-open bundle accruing interest, and one defaulted entry.
limitations: v0.1 is a local single-repo ledger: the JSONL file lives at .debtflow/ledger.jsonl and is never committed; there is no sync, shared view or debt assignment (that is the planned v0.2 team ledger server).
Interest is recomputed from local git history only — it is deterministic git-graph math, so it never judges code quality, only liability.

Agent detection is case-insensitive substring matching on author name/email and Co-Authored-By trailers (default: claude, codex, cursor); narrow it with debtflow init --agents when a human name would collide.
`debtflow default` restores the savepoint tree wholesale: commits stacked on the defaulted entry are discarded along with it.
